acceptance_criteria: Nine focused T24 tests pass unchanged.

First send verifies contact pins and persists official Signal session plus durable exact outbox state.
Ambiguous send restart retries byte-identical envelope/ciphertext with no new IDs or claim.
Prior workspace tests and package typechecks stay green.
constraints: Load task-implementer, validate the paired input, and confirm focused tests RED before editing.
Do not weaken/delete tests or edit apps/relay, flow.json, or acceptance-criteria.md.
Use apply_patch for edits and keryx ctx rg for searches; do not commit.
Preserve deterministic exact retry semantics across close/reopen and fail closed before session/outbox mutation on contact mismatch.
Write and validate the required subagent-result; final first line STATUS:.
